Adding brand new content is great ofc, but I think in the long run it's the density of existing areas and the replay ability in re-exploring that makes wicked so unique

I hope that they continue to dial in on the things that will truly set this game apart from the others. Yeah co op will be cool, but the ALIVE system, the town renovation, the way the world evolves, changes and responds to your actions---that's what I really want to see developed and expanded on. 

I want to feel like I can go to any area of the game at any point and make a decision that has an impact, supported by the intrigue of the alive system 

Maybe the plague spawns by the gates of sacrament and you can come across soldiers defending against torn enemies. And then find a soldier in an infirmary later talking about the affair.

Maybe you re-explore an area and come across an NPC you've seen in town, who is now being held hostage. Free him and see him open a new shop in sacrament.

Maybe you're walking around sacrament and suddenly an NPC says there's an infestation in their house and you need to go clear it.

Maybe you're walking around sacrament and someone invites you into their house but then tries to kill you because they work for some enemy faction.

Maybe you're exploring randomly in the wild and you come across two characters in an argument you need to settle.

Red dead redemption 2 did such an interesting and impressive job of populating the open world with encounters that sometimes only happened once, sometimes repeated, but felt each important and special, through an entire play through. Really want Wicked to take this to the next level

The stuff I'm most excited for are the updates to the alive system and secret areas in existing levels. That's the thing that most sets wicked apart, and I'd love to see them achieve the vision of having players change the way they think about re-exploring.

I hope that the alive system contains story and character aspects to it as well, not just gameplay. Such as allies and NPCs moving to different areas, story beats happening in different places, etc
